whyCareReason: AP: Zverev closed Germany 3-1 in 77 minutes. TNT Sports: Britain 4-0 Ecuador. Wikipedia: Final 8 is Italy, Canada, Czechia, Austria, South Korea, Germany, Britain, Spain.
teaser: FINAL: Germany 3-1 Croatia. AP: Zverev 6-2, 6-4. TNT Sports: Britain 4-0 Ecuador. Bologna, 24-29 November.
story:
Why this one matters: the US Open is closed. Laver Cup is still 25-27 September. Sunday named the last Davis Cup Final 8 tickets.

AP: Alexander Zverev beat Dino Prizmic 6-2, 6-4 in 77 minutes in Halle. Kevin Krawietz and Tim Puetz had beaten Nikola Mektic and Mate Pavic 7-5, 6-2. Germany 3-1 Croatia. AP: Britain through when Henry Patten and Neal Skupski beat Gonzalo Escobar and Diego Hidalgo 6-3, 6-4. TNT Sports and Wikipedia print Britain 4-0 Ecuador. Wikipedia and SuperTennis: Spain 3-0 Chile.

Wikipedia Final 8, Bologna, 24-29 November: Italy (hosts, three-time champions), Canada, Czechia, Austria, South Korea, Germany, Great Britain, Spain. Laver Cup at The O2 has not been played.
stakes: Eight nations, one indoor week in Bologna. A qualifier win is not the trophy.
rivalryAngle: A US Open champion wrapping a tie on home hard court, and a British doubles pair sending the hosts through at the Copper Box.
